name: Brew and Me
source:
Jule may be a sweet goblin noble, but softness and privilege can't get them everything. Especially when what they want is an answer to what their gender is. Meanwhile, Radiata is an elf with way more quips than she has answers. But what she lacks in tact, she instead has a willingness to help and plenty of alchemical expertise to offer. Desire and discovery are destined for these two steamy lovers. After sunset, Jule will have tasted Radiata's shape-shifting potion, her body, and something difficult to swallow: their own truth.

[From [url=https://bukothepanda.itch.io/brew-and-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
朱尔可能是一个可爱的妖精贵族，但温柔和特权并不能让他们拥有一切。尤其是当他们想要的是自己性别的答案时。与此同时，拉迪亚塔是一个俏皮话比她能回答的精灵还要多的精灵。但她缺乏机智，相反她愿意提供帮助，并且可以提供大量的炼金术专业知识。欲望和发现是这两个热情的恋人注定的。日落之后，朱尔将尝到辐射的变形药水、她的身体，以及一些难以接受的东西：他们自己的真相。

[来自[url=https://bukothepanda.itch.io/brew-and-me]itch.io[/url]]
